THE_RUNTIME_IMPLEMENTS_A_REJECTED_FAMILY.statement: the canonical runtime's de facto target is the family with the WORST measured causal delta of the three. It is an unqualified default, not a chosen target.
THE_RUNTIME_IMPLEMENTS_A_REJECTED_FAMILY.not_a_retraction_of_the_runtime: this does not say the runtime is wrong. It says no evidence qualifies its target.

WHAT_THE_PLAN_ACTUALLY_WAS.stated_next_action_before_this_stop: audit the canonical IPBEncoder(width=160), then freeze a prospective measurement-null versus biology-positive state-qualification contract, on a synthetic substrate scaled 2K -> 100K -> 500K -> 4.553M
WHAT_THE_PLAN_ACTUALLY_WAS.where_it_came_from: a scaling ladder built for MEASUREMENT ARCHITECTURE qualification. V73/V74 built a synthetic stress twin reproducing empirical donor/source/operator/QC geometry; V75 qualified it at 100K.
WHAT_THE_PLAN_ACTUALLY_WAS.the_structural_error: the next rung was written as a continuation of the same ladder, but it is a different KIND of question. Measurement-architecture qualification is engineering and needs only the generator. State qualification is science and needs a target, a trained model and a canonical vocabulary.

WHAT_THE_PLAN_ACTUALLY_WAS.honest_statement: the plan was not designed and then found defective. It accreted from a legitimate engineering ladder and was never tested for whether its next step was well-posed.

WHAT_STILL_STANDS_UNCHANGED: V75 100K measurement-architecture qualification. It is valid for its own narrow claim: the synthetic generator preserves empirical geometry at scale. That claim never depended on a target.

WHERE_SYNTHETIC_DATA_LEGITIMATELY_FITS.principle: synthetic data is a TOOL built to the specification a stage needs, not a ladder climbed for its own sake

stop_the_ladder_here.why: nothing currently needs that scale; the 100K claim is already made

WHERE_SYNTHETIC_DATA_LEGITIMATELY_FITS.the_one_design_constraint_statable_today: any synthetic substrate intended to support a target or state result must make INCREMENTAL-EVIDENCE-OVER-IDENTITY measurable: it must contain genuine cell-to-cell variation that gene identity cannot explain. A substrate without that property is structurally incapable of detecting the exact failure that rejected all three target families.

canonical_vocabulary_substrate.but: premature; its design depends on the target

EXTERNAL_LANE_STATE_CHECKED_ON_GITHUB.head: 189e6209
EXTERNAL_LANE_STATE_CHECKED_ON_GITHUB.meaning: a placeholder at the V75 head; no target has been defined there either
EXTERNAL_LANE_STATE_CHECKED_ON_GITHUB.how_it_treats_the_target: as open questions to audit, not as decided: 'What target object is constructed from richer measured evidence?' and 'Does the training path still satisfy the later teacher-target scientific corrections?'

S119.defect: my V76 audit red-teamed six premises about the STATE object and never asked the prior question of whether a target exists. Every finding was correct and all six sat on an untested premise.
S119.caught: BY_THE_PROJECT_OWNER, not by my own lane
S119.generalization: audit the premise STACK down to the objective, not only the premise handed to you. A rigorous audit of a well-specified question is worth nothing if the question is downstream of an undecided one.

S120.defect: during the V75 provenance correction I REWROTE docs/agent/V75_NEXT_ACTION_POINTER.md to name the learned 160-D state as the next action. I treated it as a documentation edit and transcribed the forward plan without auditing whether its prerequisites existed.
S120.why_it_matters: a next-action pointer is a scientific claim about what should happen next, not a record of what happened. Editing one carries the obligation to check its prerequisites.

S121.defect: my V2 artifact named 'where does the trained model store cell-specific information' as the HIGHEST priority scientific blocker. That is downstream of the target. With no qualified target there is no defined sense in which a trained model is the right model.
S121.superseded_by: the corrected dependency order above, whose step 1 is the target gate

scope: a plan-level stop. It retracts no measurement and qualifies no biology. It records that the objective the next step depended on does not exist.
